title: Zooarchaeology by Mass Spectrometry (ZooMS) for Bone Material - Acid Insoluble Protocol
author: Samantha Brown
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bf43jqyn

steps.title: Prepare 50 mM Ammonium Bicarbonate (AmBiC) Buffer
steps.instruction: Prepare a pH 8 AmBiC buffer in a clean glass bottle.

substeps.instruction: Weigh out 3.95 g of AmBiC powder.
Dissolve in 800 mL of ultrapure water and mix by gently inverting.
Fill up to 1000 mL with ultrapure water and mix by gently inverting.

steps.title: Prepare 5% (v/v) Trifluoroacetic Acid (TFA)
steps.instruction: Prepare TFA solution in a brown glass bottle under a fume hood using glass pipettes/syringes.

substeps.instruction: Dilute 1 mL TFA stock solution into 19 mL ultrapure water (pipette water first, then add acid slowly) and mix carefully.
Add 1 mL of TFA to 1000 mL of ultrapure water and mix by gently inverting.
Mix 500 mL ACN with 500 mL ultrapure water.
Carefully add 1 mL of TFA and mix by gently inverting.

steps.title: Prepare Trypsin Solution
steps.instruction: Resuspend freeze-dried Trypsin for a final concentration of 0.4 µg/µl.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend 20 µg of freeze-dried Trypsin in 50 µL of Trypsin resuspension buffer.
Transfer to a labeled 0.5 ml tube and store at -20 °C.

steps.title: Prepare 0.6 M Hydrochloric Acid (HCl)
steps.instruction: Prepare 0.6 M HCl under a fume hood.

substeps.instruction: Carefully add 50 mL of 37% (v/v) HCl to 950 mL ultrapure water.
Mix gently.

steps.title: Prepare 0.1 M Sodium Hydroxide (NaOH)
steps.instruction: Prepare 0.1 M NaOH in a clean glass bottle.

substeps.instruction: Weigh out 4 g of stock NaOH pellets.
Dissolve pellets in 800 mL of ultrapure water and mix by gently inverting.
Fill up to 1000 mL with ultrapure water.

steps.title: Sample Preparation and Weighing
steps.instruction: Weigh bone samples into labeled microcentrifuge tubes in a dedicated wet chemistry lab (surfaces wiped with ultrapure water and 70% ethanol).

substeps.instruction: Archaeological samples: Weigh 10 mg - 20 mg bone chips or ~10 mg bone powder.
Modern samples: Weigh 5 mg - 15 mg bone chips or ~7 mg bone powder.
Record the weight of each sample.

steps.title: Acid Demineralization
steps.instruction: Perform destructive demineralization of the bone material.

substeps.instruction: Add 500 µL of cold (4 °C) 0.6 M HCl (or enough to cover the sample) to the sample and prepare blanks (empty tubes with HCl).
Incubate in the fridge at 4 °C until complete (bone is flexible/spongy, no bubbling). Duration: 4-10 h for powders, 1 day to 2 weeks for other types.
Centrifuge at 20000 rpm (or high speed) for 1 minute at Room temperature.
Remove acid supernatant by pipetting. (Optional: store supernatant as 'AC' at -20 °C for acid-soluble protocol).

steps.title: Washing and Humic Acid Removal
steps.instruction: Wash samples to neutral pH and remove interfering humic acids.

substeps.instruction: Add 200 µL of 50 mM AmBic, mix by pipetting/inverting, centrifuge, and discard. Repeat 3 times (use more AmBic if sample is large; fewer washes if sample is very small).
Add 200 µL of 0.1 M NaOH, mix by pipetting/inverting, and incubate for 5 minutes at Room temperature. Centrifuge briefly and discard NaOH wash. (Skip if sample is highly degraded).
Add 200 µL of 50 mM AmBic, mix by pipetting/inverting, centrifuge briefly, and discard. Repeat 3 times (skip if NaOH step was skipped).
Add 100 µL of AmBic (use 50 µL for limited samples, or more to cover large samples) and incubate for 1 hour at 65 °C.
Label two new tubes: 'EXT' (extract) and 'SE' (second extract).
Centrifuge at 20000 rpm (or highest speed) for 1 minute at Room temperature.
Transfer 50 µL of AmBic supernatant to the 'EXT' tube and the remaining 50 µL to the 'SE' tube. (Adjust volumes if AmBic used was different).
If bone was large (>200 µL AmBic used), reduce volume to 100-200 µL via evaporation (heat block or vacuum centrifuge).
Store 'SE' tube and original bone sample (if needed) at -20 °C or dry bone at Room temperature.

steps.title: Trypsin Digestion
steps.instruction: Digest the extracted collagen into peptides.

substeps.instruction: Add 1 µL of 0.4 µg/µl trypsin solution to the 'EXT' tube.
Incubate overnight at 37 °C (approx. 12-18 hours).
Centrifuge at 20000 rpm (or highest speed) for 1 minute at Room temperature.
Add 1 µL of 5% (v/v) TFA to stop the trypsin reaction.

steps.title: C18 ZipTip Purification
steps.instruction: Purify peptides using C18 ZipTips. Use a dedicated pipette set to 100 µL and do not change the volume.

substeps.instruction: Prepare tubes per sample: 250 µL conditioning solution (C), 450 µL wash solution (W), and 50 µL conditioning solution in a 'COL' tube for collection.
Condition the tip: Rinse twice with 100 µL conditioning solution and discard.
Wash tip: Rinse twice with 100 µL wash solution and discard.
Bind sample: Resuspend the 'EXT' sample back and forth over the tip at least 5 times.
Wash bound peptides: Rinse tip twice with 100 µL wash solution and discard.
Elute: Pass 50 µL of conditioning solution through the tip at least 5 times into the 'COL' tube. Do not push air through the filter.
Store purified samples at -20 °C if not spotting immediately on MALDI plate.
